bio.text: Dan Ahlers, of Dell Rapids, is the Democratic nominee for governor of South Dakota in 2026.
According to South Dakota Searchlight's voter guide, Ahlers is a small-business owner who served six years in the Legislature.

Ahlers was executive director of the South Dakota Democratic Party and has been president of the Haven Before and After School Program, the Dell Rapids Chamber of Commerce and the Dell Rapids Community Fund.

sources.title: Democratic candidate for governor plans to lean on South Dakota's 'core values'
